subject: Submission: Milestone 2 Deliverable (Draft Revision) — Superteam Mobile SDK (grant-sol-mobile-042)
body:
Hi Superteam Grant Review Team,

We are submitting our initial progress for Milestone 2: Biometric Signer Integration.

Deliverable artifacts:
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/superteam-fun/solana-mobile-sdk/pull/42 (Commit c8f12a0 — CI build failing on integration tests)
- Test Report: 68.2% branch coverage (unit tests partially implemented)
- Documentation: In progress, draft preview at https://staging.docs.example.com/wip

Please approve early release of the 2,000 USDC allocation so we can fund our contractor for the remaining test fixes.

Best regards,
Alex Vance
Lead Engineer, Solana Mobile Builders Lab
